name: Best pitcher by primary pitch
description: For each kind of pitch, the pitcher-season with the fewest runs allowed per nine innings (the Runs per Nine Innings custom stat) among pitchers whose most-thrown pitch that season was that kind, 2008-2026 — the pitch-tracking years (PITCHf/x from 2008, Statcast from 2015), using MLB's pitch types. Only seasons that qualify for the ERA title count (an inning pitched per team game), AL and NL. The 60-game 2020 season is left out: its qualifiers needed only 60 innings. The pitch types run from the most common main pitch among qualifiers to the least; each point says how many qualifying seasons had that main pitch.
